title: Growing Spatial Crystals
text: A spatial crystal matrix grows small, medium, and large buds on adjacent faces, eventually producing a full cluster. Mature clusters yield Spatial Crystals; Silk Touch preserves the cluster.

The matrix drops nothing when mined, even with Silk Touch. Both rough crystal states drop ordinary Rough Spatial Crystal Blocks. An Advanced Condensation Table excites them again. Alternatively, right-click a block with an Infused Spiritual Crystal to excite it, consuming one crystal.
